title: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled RNA therapeutic design: from molecular optimization to system-level evaluation.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述AI驱动的RNA治疗设计，涵盖序列、生成和结构感知模型，虽涉及结构约束优化但核心对象为RNA而非蛋白质，算法框架可部分迁移至蛋白质结构计算，故评5分。
abstract: RNA therapeutics are increasingly moving from empirical screening towards rational, computation-guided design. Recent advances in RNA language models, generative models and structure-aware learning have improved sequence representation, candidate generation and structure-constrained optimization. However, favourable molecular properties do not necessarily translate into desirable biological performance, because therapeutic outcomes also depend on modality-specific mechanisms, delivery and exposure, molecular interactions, cellular state, immune responses and network-level adaptation. Here, we review AI-enabled RNA therapeutic design through the specific lens of the interface between molecular optimization and system-level evaluation. We compare the design constraints of siRNAs, antisense oligonucleotides, aptamers, mRNAs and translation-oriented circRNAs, and examine the capabilities and current limitations of sequence-, generative- and structure-based computational models. We further discuss the data resources and perturbation representations required to connect molecular candidates with broader cellular-response models. In this context, virtual cells are considered as approximate computational frameworks for candidate prioritization and risk-oriented system-level assessment rather than complete digital replicas of living cells. Finally, we outline a conceptual generation-simulation-feedback-optimization framework for integrating molecular design with progressively higher-level evaluation. This perspective emphasizes the need for better interfaces among RNA design, pharmacological context and cellular-response modelling, rather than relying on molecular optimization alone.
abstract_zh: RNA疗法正日益从经验性筛选转向理性的、计算引导的设计。RNA语言模型、生成模型和结构感知学习的最新进展改善了序列表示、候选生成和结构约束优化。然而，有利的分子特性并不一定能转化为理想的生物学性能，因为治疗结果还依赖于模态特异性机制、递送和暴露、分子相互作用、细胞状态、免疫反应及网络层面的适应性。在此，我们通过分子优化与系统级评估之间接口的特定视角，综述了AI驱动的RNA治疗设计。我们比较了siRNA、反义寡核苷酸、适配体、mRNA和翻译导向的circRNA的设计约束，并考察了基于序列、生成和结构的计算模型的能力及当前局限性。我们进一步讨论了将分子候选与更广泛的细胞反应模型连接所需的数据资源和扰动表示。在此背景下，虚拟细胞被视为候选优先级排序和风险导向系统级评估的近似计算框架，而非活细胞的完整数字复制品。最后，我们概述了一个概念性的生成-模拟-反馈-优化框架，用于将分子设计与逐步更高级别的评估相结合。这一视角强调，需要改善RNA设计、药理学背景和细胞反应建模之间的接口，而非仅依赖分子优化。
